title: Zeus Juice Black Reloaded E-Liquid 50ml Shortfill
description: Black Reloaded takes Zeus’ signature Black eliquid and complements the rich sweetness of ripe dark berries and sharp blackcurrants with a delicate balance of fire and ice from aniseed and menthol. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
